_read_me: Aparna's events, newest first. Each becomes a page at /events/<id>/ and a card on /events/. To add one: put its photos in a folder (for example events-media/<id>/, any .jpg/.png/.webp), add an entry here with that folder, then run npm run content. Paths are relative to the project folder; "pack:" means the build pack folder. Photo captions come from "captions" (file name -> caption) or else from the file names (text before " - " or the whole name), so name files by what they show, never by people's names (brief rule 4). galleries: optional named sets (a folder each, shown in file-name order). video: an optional muted loop (.mp4). drones: optional muted drone loops [{ file, label, poster }]. afterMovie: link to the full film (YouTube) once Aparna sends it, or null. hide: optional photos left out of the page ("file name" or "folder name/file name"; the originals stay in the pack). launches: optional category names launched at the event (linked to their pages). marquee: the lines in the marigold ribbon on the event page (and on /events/ for the newest event), in order; written exactly as they should read (the ribbon shows them in capitals); without it the ribbon shows the kicker and the name and month.
